operation.source_intent: Render Cancel only when ShowCancel is enabled; disable it only while Busy or CancelDisabled; otherwise invoke the supplied OnCancel callback without creating an independent request.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The existing shared Laravel form-actions wrapper exposes the canonical cancel marker on its real Site Onboarding consumer, honors ShowCancel, Busy and cancelDisabled, and delegates only to the caller-owned onCancel callback.
laravel_adaptation.authorization: The shared control is rendered only for sites.manage (or *) in the server-authored tenant FrontendContext.

security_boundary.tenant_context: The mounted onboarding flow is selected from the authenticated tenant context; no caller-supplied tenant selector is added by the cancel control.
security_boundary.tenant_isolation_test: The focused SiteOnboardingSaveTestAndSyncTerminalityTest retains an explicit foreign-tenant /api/tenants/beta/sites/onboarding assertNotFound check.
security_boundary.authorization_test: The same focused feature test retains an explicit missing sites.manage assertForbidden check.
security_boundary.external_state: Cancel is local wizard navigation only; it performs no WordPress, connector, queue or persistence mutation.

coverage: cancel remains independent of the local save-dispatch de-duplication guard
no request or mutation inside the shared cancel control
